entries.heading: 10. Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants
entries.text: 10. Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants --The mention of his sons and the slaves in his house was to show that Mephibosheth would be honored with an equipage "as one of the king's sons."

entries.heading: 12. Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micah
entries.text: 12. Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micah --Whether born before or after his residence in Jerusalem, cannot be ascertained. But through him the name and memory of the excellent Jonathan was preserved (see 1Ch 8:34, 35; 9:40, 41 ).
